result.instructions: Tools for SOS Inventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items are below their reorder point right now?"; "Show me the open sales orders for this month."; "What is on hand and available for SKU 4878932?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SOS Inventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sosinventory_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sosinventory_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sosinventory_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sosinventory_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List or search inventory items (products, assemblies, services...) with SKU, type, quantities (onhand, available, on sales/purchase orders) and prices. Filter by free text, SKU, category, type, tags, ids or update time; pass location to see quantities at one location. GET /api/v2/item.

query.description: Free-text search over item name, SKU, description and similar fields.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; records matching them are returned.

location.description: Location name: quantities then reflect that location.

updated_since.description: Only items created or updated since this local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

summary.description: true (default) = summary records without line items and long sub-lists; false = full records.

start.description: 1-based row number to start at (default 1). Pass next_start from the previous reply to read the next page.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One item by id with all fields: quantities, prices, accounts, vendor, category, units of measure, price tiers, custom fields. GET /api/v2/item/{id}.

location.description: Location name: quantities then reflect that location.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_item_bom
tools.title: Get item bill of materials
tools.description: The bill of materials of an assembly item: component items, quantities and costs. GET /api/v2/item/{id}/bom.

id.description: SOS item id of the assembly.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers with contact details, billing/shipping addresses, terms, sales rep and credit-hold flag. Filter by name/notes text, name, email or update time. GET /api/v2/customer.

query.description: Free-text search over the customer name, full name and notes (use `email` for an email lookup).

name.description: Match on the customer name or full name.

updated_since.description: Only customers created or updated since this local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

summary.description: true (default) = summary records without line items and long sub-lists; false = full records.

start.description: 1-based row number to start at (default 1). Pass next_start from the previous reply to read the next page.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_customer

updated_since.description: Only vendors created or updated since this local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

summary.description: true (default) = summary records without line items and long sub-lists; false = full records.

start.description: 1-based row number to start at (default 1). Pass next_start from the previous reply to read the next page.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_vendor
tools.title: Get vendor
tools.description: One vendor by id with all fields. GET /api/v2/vendor/{id}.

query.description: Free-text search over number, customer/vendor name, reference fields and similar.

from.description: Transaction date on or after this (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). `to` is optional.

to.description: Transaction date on or before this (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). `from` is optional.

updated_since.description: Only transactions created or updated since this local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

summary.description: true (default) = summary records without line items and long sub-lists; false = full records.

start.description: 1-based row number to start at (default 1). Pass next_start from the previous reply to read the next page.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_transactions
tools.title: List other transactions
tools.description: List any SOS transaction type: invoices, estimates, sales receipts, item receipts, shipments, pick tickets, work orders, builds, adjustments, transfers, RMAs, returns, returns to vendor, rentals, rental returns and processes. Filters: query, date range, updated_since; status (open/closed; invoices voided/notvoided; estimates accepted/pending/closed/rejected; not available for transfers, shipments, builds, returns, item receipts, processes); location (transfers, rentals and rental returns take from_location/to_location instead). GET /api/v2/{type}.

query.description: Free-text search over number, customer/vendor name, reference fields and similar.

from.description: Transaction date on or after this (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). `to` is optional.

to.description: Transaction date on or before this (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). `from` is optional.

updated_since.description: Only transactions created or updated since this local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

summary.description: true (default) = summary records without line items and long sub-lists; false = full records.

start.description: 1-based row number to start at (default 1). Pass next_start from the previous reply to read the next page.

status.description: Status filter; the allowed values depend on the type (see the tool description).

from_location.description: Transfers, rentals, rental returns: the source location name.

to_location.description: Transfers, rentals, rental returns: the destination location name.

tools.name: sosinventory_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One transaction of any type by id, with all fields and line items. GET /api/v2/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: sosinventory_list_reference_data
tools.title: List reference data
tools.description: List a configuration or reference table: locations, channels, classes, departments, payment terms, tax codes, sales reps, ship methods, payment methods, priorities, order stages, price tiers, units of measure, users (id, name, email), accounts, custom fields, warranties, bins, workers, work centers, jobs, lots or serial numbers. Use it to find the ids and names that the create tools reference. GET /api/v2/{type}.

type.description: Which table to list (the API endpoint name).

query.description: Free-text filter (supported by some tables, e.g. job, lot, serial).

start.description: 1-based row number to start at (default 1). Pass next_start from the previous reply to read the next page.

tools.name: sosinventory_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new customer record in SOS Inventory. Only name is required. Check sosinventory_list_customers first so you do not create a duplicate. POST /api/v2/customer.

name.description: Customer name (how it is looked up in SOS).

notes.description: Internal notes (not shown to the customer).

tools.name: sosinventory_create_vendor
tools.title: Create vendor
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new vendor (supplier) record in SOS Inventory. Only name is required. Check sosinventory_list_vendors first to avoid a duplicate. POST /api/v2/vendor.

name.description: Vendor name (how it is looked up in SOS).

account_number.description: Your account number with this vendor.

tools.name: sosinventory_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new inventory item. Optionally books initial stock: SOS then creates an inventory adjustment for the quantity at the given location. Item names must be unique within their category: check sosinventory_list_items first. POST /api/v2/item.

type.description: Item type (SOS's default applies when omitted).

category.description: Existing category (a category cannot be created here).

initial_quantity.description: Opening stock. Needs initial_location; SOS books an adjustment for it.

initial_value.description: Total value of the opening stock.

initial_location.description: Location name that receives the opening stock (type=location).

tools.name: sosinventory_create_sales_order
tools.title: Create sales order
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new sales order for an EXISTING customer with line items for existing items (a customer or item cannot be created inside an order: use the create tools first). The order number is assigned automatically (SOS auto-numbering) unless you pass one. Confirm the customer, items, quantities and prices with the user before calling. POST /api/v2/salesorder.

item.description: Item (by id or name; see sosinventory_list_items).

unit_price.description: Price per unit (sales: must not be below the item's minimum price).

date.description: Order date (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS); defaults to now in SOS.

number.description: Order number; leave out for SOS's automatic numbering.

comment.description: Internal comment (not shown to the customer).

tools.name: sosinventory_create_purchase_order
tools.title: Create purchase order
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new purchase order to an EXISTING vendor with line items for existing items. The PO number is assigned automatically unless you pass one. Confirm the vendor, items, quantities and costs with the user before calling. POST /api/v2/purchaseorder.

item.description: Item (by id or name; see sosinventory_list_items).

unit_price.description: Price per unit (sales: must not be below the item's minimum price).

lines.description: PO lines (unit_price = purchase cost per unit).

date.description: Order date (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS); defaults to now in SOS.

number.description: PO number; leave out for automatic numbering.
